From: Jane Davies <jane.davies@brightlayer.io>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 11 Apr 2026 08:32:00 -0700
Subject: BrightLayer: Marketplace vendor onboarding & PO path

Hi Soojin,

Hope you're well — BrightLayer is planning to list our data-inference connector across AWS/Azure/GCP marketplaces and we'd like to start the vendor onboarding and PO discussion. Two quick asks: a) what specific procurement paperwork does Redwood need for marketplace-enabled billing (PO routing, tax forms, MPN/partner IDs), and b) what is your typical lead time from intake -> go-live for a marketplace listing?

I've attached our intake_form_v1.pdf with basic company details and the procurement contact (procure@brightlayer.io). We are aiming for a June go-live but flexible depending on paperwork and PO timelines.

Attachments: intake_form_v1.pdf (vendor intake draft)

Thanks — Jane
Jane Davies
Head of Partnerships, BrightLayer
jane.davies@brightlayer.io
+1 415-555-0199
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Jane Davies <jane.davies@brightlayer.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 11 Apr 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BrightLayer: Marketplace vendor onboarding & PO path

Hi Jane — thanks for the intake doc, and welcome. Short answers up front: Redwood supports marketplace listings across AWS/Azure/GCP; procurement paperwork we need: completed intake form, tax docs (W-9 or local equivalent), billing contact, preferred invoice terms (Net30/45), and if you're using a reseller/partner MPN details. For marketplace-specific listing (metered billing) we also need the product SKU mapping and the marketplace agreement signed (DocuSign).

I've looped in Ben (billing/finance) to open the PO and Vanessa (marketplace ops) to shepherd the marketplace activation. Next steps I propose:
- BrightLayer: confirm billing contact + complete intake_form_completed.pdf and attach tax docs (W-9)
- Ben: open a vendor profile and confirm PO routing and payment terms
- Vanessa: confirm marketplace agreement type and provide the DocuSign link for signature

I'll track and coordinate. If you'd like a short call to align timelines I can set one up this week.

Best,
So 
So Sojin Lee
Head of GTM Partnerships, Redwood Inference

Finance,

Forwarding BrightLayer intake for vendor setup. BrightLayer (BL) expects to transact via cloud marketplaces; estimated first-year spend roughly $120k ARR (metered SKUs). Can you please:
- Open vendor profile for BrightLayer (legal name on intake form).
- Advise on PO creation and whether we can support Net30 (preferred) or require Net45 for marketplace contracts.
- Flag any tax or compliance holds for marketplace billing.

I've attached my notes from the intake: vendor_intake_notes.docx. Let me know if you need the signed marketplace agreement before raising the PO.

Thanks,
Ben Carter

Soojin — thanks, Ben and Vanessa. Attached is the completed intake form and our tax document (pdf). We prefer Net30; billing contact is finance@brightlayer.io. Also attaching intake_form_completed.pdf and brightlayer_tax_document.pdf.

For the marketplace agreement: BrightLayer is fine signing standard marketplace terms; please send the DocuSign when ready. Regarding timeline: we can be flexible but aim for the first week of June (would like to be in time for a partner marketing push on June 10). Doable if paperwork and PO are in place by late May.

2) BrightLayer returns signed marketplace agreement via DocuSign (I will send link) — target: by 2026-05-01
3) Marketplace SKU mapping & technical preflight (Redwood + BrightLayer) — target: 2026-05-10
4) Marketplace listing QA & final approvals — target: 2026-05-24
5) Go-live window — target: week of 2026-06-07 (aligned with your June 10 marketing push)

Action items:
- Jane: sign marketplace_agreement_docusign.pdf when you receive it; confirm any reseller/MPN IDs to include in the agreement
- Ben: confirm PO terms (Net30) and notify when PO number issued
- Soojin: please confirm if we should schedule a 30-minute technical preflight with BrightLayer engineering next week

Links: HubSpot: https://hubspot.company/record/BL-4392 (I will update) | DocuSign will be sent moments after this email.
